_howto: Newest first. Edit this file and push — every student's app picks it up on next open. 'pinned' keeps an item at the top. 'expires' (yyyy-MM-dd) hides it after that date. 'delayDays' turns on the 2-Hour Delay schedule for everyone on those dates.

items.title: Thanksgiving Break
items.body: No school Wednesday, November 25 through Friday, November 27. Classes resume Monday, November 30.

items.title: End of 1st Semester is December 17
items.body: The 2nd 9 weeks and 1st semester end Thursday, December 17. Christmas Break starts Friday, December 18.

items.title: Welcome to Student Agenda
items.body: Add your classes under Settings, then track homework on the Homework tab. Your homework stays on this device — it is never sent anywhere. Use Settings → Back up to save a copy.
